title: Metadata-first Game Registration Inspection Checklist

difMold.role: DIF projection scaffold. Slots describe required evidence, not populated game facts.

flow: later DIF projection onto the 98-node mold
engineSteps: map into nearest valid GRID root
coverageRule: DIF node presence is not inspection completeness. Partial never means complete. Missing categories stay visible. Game-specific adapter coverage is not game-agnostic completeness.

rules: Preserve ambiguity instead of guessing when evidence does not resolve.
Unresolved remains explicit; it is not selectable truth.
A missing hash is Unresolved, not proof of absence.
Adapters must not mutate admitted source bytes.
Source-owned names are copied exactly; GRID identity points at source identity and does not rename.

engineDistinction.thisContract: Proposed inspection checklist for what GRID must inspect before a canonical projection is trustworthy. Reviewable artifact only. Not loaded by CanonicalRegistrationChecklist.Load().

implementedContract2.candidateEngine: CanonicalRegistrationEngine emits CanonicalRegistrationCandidate with publicationState NOT_PUBLISHED.

implementedDifMold.constraint: Exactly 98 authored nodes and six selector roots.

engineDistinction.implementedConnection: Add Game / installation stores / MO2 two-pass registration are connection/catalog, not this inspection contract.
notWired: CanonicalRegistrationEngine.Evaluate does not read this file.
Workstation Refresh and DIF behavior are unchanged.

gapMap.note: Game-specific collectors exist; not a comprehensive inspection authority.
Substantial on some Location/Item/Actor/Mission evidence; not game-agnostic completeness.
Candidate verification must not enter these paths.

assumptions.text: Repo GRID.md is the product contract. Linear uploads are not substitutes.
canonical-registration-checklist.v1.json remains the DIF mold and is not this inspection checklist.
GRID.md GAME REGISTRATION implemented names Contract 2 / library registration, not complete physical inspection of every category.
This file is not an EmbeddedResource and is not loaded by the registration engine. Wiring it into Evaluate would be a later, separate change.
Existing install-id formulas stay distinct and are not unified in v1.
If a later machine schema is needed beyond this JSON, add a sibling file rather than replacing this version or the 98-node mold.

escalations.question: May candidate-only proof set publicationState other than NOT_PUBLISHED?
May inspection skip File/Reference evidence or treat Unresolved as selectable truth?
May a candidate graph trigger KnowledgeRebuild import, Workstation Refresh publish, or populated live DIF?

categories.name: Game identity
categories.inspect: Stable GameId, source-owned names, GRID key pointing at source identity; GRID does not rename.
categories.v1Default: Keep existing GameIds. Do not add a third identity family.

categories.name: Edition / build / platform
categories.inspect: Distinct editions and observed build/file version. Legacy is not Enhanced; SE is not VR.
categories.v1Default: Edition is identity. Do not merge editions. Unobserved build/platform stays Unresolved.

categories.name: Installation roots and executables
categories.inspect: Canonical install root, required executable beneath it, user-data roots, manager instance roots.
categories.v1Default: Keep existing install-id formulas. User-data roots are descriptors, not proof of connection.

categories.name: Packages / DLC / updates
categories.inspect: Official packages, DLC, updates, Creations/CCC, version migration.
categories.v1Default: Keep the category visible. Record Observed/Unresolved only. No package schema in v1.

categories.name: Files and hashes
categories.inspect: Bounded file identity, SHA-256, change-during-read, size, readability.
categories.v1Default: SHA-256 only. Missing hash is Unresolved, not absence. Do not require full-tree hashing for v1 trust.

categories.name: Manifests
categories.inspect: Provider, adapter, capability, plugin, archive, and recipe manifests.
categories.v1Default: Each manifest family is evidence, not the library.

categories.name: Assets
categories.inspect: Meshes, textures, scripts, archives, winners, declared versus provided paths.
categories.v1Default: Keep visible. Do not claim a shared asset catalog.

categories.name: Native record families and IDs
categories.inspect: Native family, canonical native ID, defining plugin, EditorID, data hash where evidenced.
grounding: GRID.md do not assume stable mission IDs
categories.v1Default: Native and game-owned keys. Unstable IDs stay Unresolved.

categories.name: Localization
categories.inspect: Locale and alias fields on names/records, plus source-owned terminology. String tables only when a native adapter already exposes them; they are not implied by Partial.
categories.v1Default: Partial means locale/alias fields exist (RegistrationName.Locale, DIF locale requirements). It does not mean string-table completeness.

categories.name: Locations / world records
categories.inspect: Worlds, cells, places, and evidence-backed hierarchy including fractional levels.
categories.v1Default: Map to nearest Location anchor. Do not coerce geography into the mold.

categories.name: Actors
categories.inspect: Player and non-player actors, factions, placed versus base identities.
categories.v1Default: Keep actor versus placed-actor distinct.

categories.name: Items
categories.inspect: Weapons, wearables, vehicles-as-items, consumables, magic, and related native records.
categories.v1Default: Native records plus relationships. No extra shared taxonomy in v1.

categories.name: Missions
categories.inspect: Story, DLC, Online, and Mod jobs or quests.
categories.v1Default: Inventory is not mission understanding. Keep Unresolved when native IDs are absent.

categories.name: Vehicles
categories.inspect: Vehicle identities, models, and world links.
categories.v1Default: Keep visible. Do not map TES4 families onto vehicles.

categories.name: Relationships
categories.inspect: Containment, masters, providers, load order, references, enable-parents, and manager relationships.
categories.v1Default: The candidate graph is the Contract 2 output. Unresolved edges stay Unresolved.

categories.name: Overrides
categories.inspect: Winning versus defining records and files.
categories.v1Default: Keep file versus record overrides separate. Override is not a defect.

categories.name: Conflicts
categories.inspect: Record conflicts, asset conflicts, and compatibility observations.
categories.v1Default: IncompleteEvidence and Contradictory remain valid. Community intel is not executable truth.

categories.name: Provenance
categories.inspect: Source, adapter, time, SHA-256, ruling tags, and verificationStatus.
categories.v1Default: Reuse evidence/provenance contracts. Do not weaken ruling tags.

categories.name: Applicability
categories.inspect: Which game, edition, installation, and profile a candidate is about. Implemented Contract 2 RegistrationApplicability remains GameId plus optional ProfileId only; edition and installation are inspection facts, not extra applicability fields.
grounding: all 98 DIF nodes require game and profile
categories.v1Default: Do not widen RegistrationApplicability in v1. Bind candidates to GameId and optional ProfileId. Record edition and installation as evidence-backed facts when observed; leave them Unresolved when not.

categories.name: Operational instructions
categories.inspect: Installation, configuration, usage, compatibility, update, uninstall, and troubleshooting guidance.
grounding: GRID.md original instructions are part of registration
categories.v1Default: Keep visible. Instructions are inspection evidence of required operator action, not auto-execution.

categories.name: Tools (launch versus knowledge)
categories.inspect: Launch configuration can work while integration knowledge remains unresolved.
categories.v1Default: Launch config works unresolved. Integration knowledge stays Unresolved until evidenced.
